readOnly.title: You can read these settings, not change them

elsewhere.title: Changed by someone else
elsewhere.body: Someone changed these settings on another screen. Reload to see theirs; what you typed here and did not save stays until you reload.

keys.title: Keys of this list
keys.edit: Change the cell (or open its choice)
keys.cancel: Leave the cell as it was
keys.undo: Take back the last change (while it is still yours)

held.same: Nothing to change: the values are the same.

methodHint.ORDERS: The plan buys or makes what the orders need, plus the safety stock.
methodHint.MANUAL: The plan shows the item but never suggests an order for it: someone orders it by hand.
methodHint.REORDER_POINT: When the stock position falls to the reorder point, the plan orders the lot size (as many lots as bring it above).
methodHint.MIN_MAX: When the stock position falls below the minimum, the plan orders up to the maximum.

field.horizonWeeks: How far the plan looks ahead
field.dayBucketWeeks: Days up to the end of week
field.weekBucketWeeks: Weeks up to the end of week

problem.days: {field} is a whole number of calendar days, 0 to 366.
problem.quantity: {field} is a quantity in the item's base unit: digits, with a point or comma for decimals.
problem.maxStock: The maximum stock must be above the minimum ({min}).
problem.maxOrder: The order maximum may not be below the order minimum ({min}).
problem.ropNeeds: A reorder-point rule needs both the reorder point and the lot size.
problem.ropOnly: {field} belongs to the reorder-point method: change the method first.
problem.minMaxNeeds: A min/max rule needs both the minimum and the maximum stock.
problem.minMaxOnly: {field} belongs to the min/max method: change the method first.
problem.supplierBuy: A preferred supplier goes with an item bought here.
problem.makeSiteMake: A make site goes with an item made at a plant.
problem.note: A note has at most 500 characters.
problem.refusedField: The factory refused {field} as it is: check the value.
problem.percent: Give a percent above 0 and at most 200, with at most two decimals (85 or 92.5).
problem.people: Give 1 to 500 people, or leave it empty for one per active station.

pp.cleared_one: Saved. {fields} was cleared: it belongs to the method or source before.
pp.cleared_other: Saved. {fields} were cleared: they belong to the method or source before.

undo.done: The last change of {item} was taken back.
undo.notOurs: The last change can no longer be taken back: the row changed since.

import.label: Import
import.held: No importer for item parameters exists yet: type them here, or change many rows at once with Edit.

items.title: Item parameters
items.hint: How {site} plans each item and colour: lead times, safety stock, order minimum, step and maximum, bought or made. An item with no row follows its own defaults (shown faint). Quantities are in the item's base unit.
items.noMatch: No item matches the search or the filters

empty.title: No items yet
empty.body: Items appear here once Products › Materials & trims has them.

methodDialog.title: How {item} is planned
methodDialog.clears: Saving clears {fields}: it belongs to the method before.

sourceDialog.title: Where {item} comes from
sourceDialog.suppliersHint: The item's own supplier and its approved sources.
sourceDialog.suppliersFailed: The approved sources could not be read: the item's own supplier is offered.
sourceDialog.suppliersHeld: Picking a preferred supplier needs the purchasing right (purchasing.view) to read the approved sources.
sourceDialog.noPlants: No plant of this company to make it at.

bulk.defaultsNone: None of the selected rows has parameters of its own.
bulk.hint: Tick the fields to change. An empty value clears the field on every row.
bulk.methodHint: A reorder rule needs its own values: set it on the row or in Reorder rules.
bulk.pickField: Tick at least one field to change.
bulk.counts: {write} will be saved · {refused} refused · {same} already so
bulk.nothing: No row has a change that can be saved.

defaults.body: The site's parameters of these rows are removed; the items are planned by their own defaults again. You can set them again at any time.
defaults.done_one: {count} row now follows the item's defaults.
defaults.done_other: {count} rows now follow the items' defaults.

reorder.title: Reorder rules
reorder.hint: Reorder point or min/max per item and colour. Rules are kept per site: the warehouse is {site} as a whole (not one location inside it).
reorder.notThisMethod: Not used by this rule's method

empty.title: No reorder rules
empty.body: Items are planned from orders only.

reorder.toOrdersBody: Their reorder rules end and their reorder values are cleared; the plan orders what the orders need.
reorder.toOrdersDone_one: {count} item is planned from orders now.
reorder.toOrdersDone_other: {count} items are planned from orders now.

rule.title: New reorder rule
rule.itemHint: Type a code or a name, then pick the item.
rule.searchFailed: The search did not answer: try again.
rule.hasRow: This item already has parameters for this colour (planned: {method}): saving changes them.

horizon.title: Horizon & fences
horizon.hint: The plan counts in days first, then weeks, then months up to its horizon.
horizon.isDefault: This site uses the defaults (26 weeks; days for 2 weeks; weeks to week 13). Saving keeps its own settings.
horizon.horizonHint: 1 to 104 weeks; this week is week 1.
horizon.dayHint: Days in the plan up to the end of this week (0: no day buckets).
horizon.weekHint: Weeks up to the end of this week; months after it.
horizon.efficiencyHint: For a line or work centre without its own planned %.
horizon.onDemandHint: The plan runs only when someone starts it.
horizon.noPreview: Fix the fields to see the buckets.
horizon.fencesLater: Time fences (frozen, firming, forecast, capacity) come in a later version.
horizon.saved_one: Saved: {count} setting changed. The next plan uses it.
horizon.saved_other: Saved: {count} settings changed. The next plan uses them.

problem.horizon: The plan looks {min} to {max} weeks ahead.
problem.dayAfterWeek: Day buckets ({days} weeks) end before the week buckets do (week {weeks}).
problem.weekAfterHorizon: Week buckets (week {weeks}) end within the horizon ({horizon} weeks).
problem.runTime: The nightly run is a time HH:MM (02:00).
problem.refused: The factory refused this value: check it.

actual.label: Actual efficiency of {lane}, last 4 weeks
actual.none: Not counted for a work centre

efficiency.title: Line efficiency
efficiency.hint: Planned efficiency per line, with the actual history next to it.
efficiency.hintSite: Planned efficiency per line, with the actual history next to it. Without its own %, a lane plans at the site's default ({pct} %).
efficiency.hintDefault: Planned efficiency per line, with the actual history next to it. Without its own %, a lane plans at {pct} % (no site default set).

empty.title: No lines yet
empty.body: Lines and work centres are set up on the site.

efficiency.privacy: Efficiency is counted per line and work centre only, never per person.
